title.en: Ibadan in indigo and maker marks
title.zh: 靛蓝与署名中的伊巴丹

alt.en: An indigo-blue cloth is divided into patterned squares, with pale columns, curved shapes, stars and fine geometric lines; a seam crosses its middle.
alt.zh: 靛蓝布面分成花纹方格，浅色柱形、曲线、星形和细密几何线条相间，中央横贯一道拼缝。

caption.en: Àdìrẹ ẹlé̩kọ wrapper, unrecorded Yorùbá artists, Nigeria, c.1960. Cotton and indigo; Princeton University Art Museum, 2018-129.
caption.zh: 阿迪雷淀粉防染围布，姓名未详的约鲁巴制作者，尼日利亚，约1960年。棉布与靛蓝；普林斯顿大学艺术博物馆，2018-129。

interpretation.en: Princeton identifies the Mapo Hall motif and two maker marks. Two makers are a possibility, not an established identification. This is a different cloth from the V&A examples discussed in the story.
interpretation.zh: 普林斯顿馆方识别出马波市政厅图案与两个制作者标记。两人合作只是可能解释，尚未确证。这件布不同于正文讨论的维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆藏例。

items.creator: Unrecorded Yorùbá artists
items.credit: Image courtesy of the Princeton University Art Museum. Museum purchase, Hugh Leander Adams, Mary Trumbull Adams and Hugh Trumbull Adams Princeton Art Fund, and anonymous gift (2018-129).

note.en: This exact object page offers a public-domain image download. Museum policy permits free use of downloadable public-domain images and distinguishes restricted works, which cannot be downloaded.
note.zh: 此单件页面提供公共领域图像下载。馆方政策允许自由使用可下载的公共领域图像，并与不能下载的受限作品明确区分。

transformation.en: Official 1024-pixel derivative saved unchanged, retaining the cloth edges and central seam.
transformation.zh: 原样保存官方1024像素衍生图，保留布边与中央拼缝。
